title: Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) Fee Rule: Charging and Reversing the Filing Fee
content:
**Fee rule clauses (in force unless marked otherwise)**

(a) *No longer in force:* "The filing fee is the certificate's filing fee, charged once when a filing is requested for a reason in the charged list and billed on the backing term's billing plan." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

(b) *No longer in force:* "Only one filing fee is charged per filing request." This clause is no longer in force and is superseded by the current basis.

(c) No fee is charged for a corrected refiling, and none when a renewal term carries the certificate forward.

(d) The fee is fully earned once the certificate is transmitted. It is not returned when the backing term later cancels.

(e) A charged filing fee is reversed at most once.

(f) A reversal is made only for a request withdrawn before it was ever transmitted, a fee charged in error, or a duplicate request. The reversal is for the fee's full amount.

### How clause (e) is checked

Whether a fee has already been reversed is read from the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) fee ledger, before the reversal is booked. The check looks for an existing reversal that names the same fee transaction.

### Grounds for reversal under clause (f)

| Ground | Reversal |
|---|---|
| request withdrawn before it was ever transmitted | yes, full amount |
| fee charged in error | yes, full amount |
| duplicate request | yes, full amount |
| request withdrawn after the certificate was transmitted | not on the withdrawal ground |
| backing term cancelled after transmission | no (clause d) |

### Hypothetical ledgers

- **Reversed once.** A fee reversed once as a duplicate request already has its reversal; clause (e) allows no second reversal of that fee.
- **Partial reversal.** A reversal made under clause (f) is never for part of the fee.
